This role exists to solve a key business need: increasing creative output, improving execution speed, and reducing revision cycles while elevating the quality of edits through advanced AI workflows.

This is a production-first role focused primarily on editing, post-production, and AI-enhanced creative, not traditional filming.

You will work closely with Creative, Growth, and Marketing partners to deliver performance-focused assets that directly impact campaign velocity.


Who we are: Organics Ocean

We are a premium direct-to-consumer supplement brand helping people live healthier lives through science-backed, clean, and effective products.

We’re not a company where things stay the same. We test, we optimize, we innovate—and we want someone who thrives in that kind of high-accountability, fast-paced environment.


Why join our team?


High-growth eCommerce brand: Driven by innovation and fast execution, Organics Ocean has seen 350% year over year growth.


Ownership & Accountability: We trust our team members to take full ownership of their responsibilities. You are empowered to lead, execute, and improve without micromanagement. We value individuals who take initiative, hold themselves accountable, and drive meaningful results.


A team of high performers: We push boundaries, move fast, and get things done. The company is in a hockey stick growth phase. This is not a good fit for those who don’t want to grow.


Responsibilities

Direct Response Video Editing

  • Produce high-quality paid social performance creatives
  • Execute UGC edits, AI creative, AI UGC, mini-VSL, and VSL formats
  • Optimize pacing, hooks, and CTAs for conversion
  • Deliver high output with minimal revision cycles

AI Video Workflow Integration

  • Use AI tools to accelerate production and improve quality
  • Create both AI-forward and AI-assisted realistic creatives
  • Continuously test new AI workflows to improve performance

Creative Collaboration

  • Partner with Creative Strategy to execute briefs
  • Attend creative meetings to reduce revision loops
  • Align closely with Creative leadership on feedback

Production & Workflow Support

  • Act as a point of contact between Creative Lead and external editors
  • Help disseminate process updates and feedback to contractors
  • Support operational efficiency and creative throughput

Filming (Secondary Responsibility)

  • Occasional product shots or B-roll when needed


What success looks like


First 90 Days

  • Fully ramp into Rain Media’s performance creative workflow and AI editing stack
  • Deliver consistent weekly output aligned to creative briefs and paid social requirements
  • Demonstrate proficiency using required AI tools within real production workflows
  • Reduce revision cycles by actively participating in creative meetings and feedback loops
  • Establish clear collaboration rhythms with Creative leadership and external editors
  • Begin contributing process improvements that increase speed and execution quality

In 12 months:

  • Consistently deliver 15–20 high-performing creatives per week with strong execution speed
  • Become a key leverage point for creative production, supporting communication with external editors and improving workflow efficiency
  • Elevate overall creative quality through advanced AI integration and experimentation
  • Maintain a standard of ≤1 revision cycle between strategy and editing whenever possible
  • Help scale creative volume without sacrificing performance or brand quality
  • Contribute to evolving Rain Media’s AI-first creative production framework


Requirements

Requirements (Expected Proficiencies to Excel in This Role)

  • Ability to communicate (speak/write) fluent English
  • 2 + yrs proven experience editing direct response performance creatives for paid social platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)
  • Must have AI video experience and samples to showcase your work
  • Strong understanding of conversion-focused editing, including hooks, pacing, storytelling, and call-to-action structure
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high-volume creative output in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment
  • Hands-on experience using AI video generation and enhancement tools within production workflows
  • Proficiency with core editing platforms such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of creative design tools such as Canva, Photoshop, or Figma
  • Experience collaborating closely with creative strategists, growth teams, or performance marketing teams
  • Ability to interpret creative briefs and execute with minimal revision cycles
  • Strong communication skills and comfort participating in real-time feedback sessions
  • Ability to manage multiple creative experiments simultaneously while maintaining speed and quality

AI & Technical Proficiency (Required)

  • Experience working with tools such as Higgsfield, Google V3/Gemini workflows , or similar AI-driven platforms
  • Understanding of AI-assisted editing techniques, including both overt AI creative and realistic AI integrations

Nice-to-Have Proficiencies

  • Experience with advanced AI platforms such as Sora, Kling , or emerging generative video tools
  • Familiarity with open-source AI workflows or technical experimentation across AI ecosystems
  • Background supporting or coordinating external video editors or creative contractors

Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to work within US time zones (Eastern preferred)
  • Access to a work computer, a reliable internet connection and a distraction-free workspace
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response and AI-enhanced video work


Offer Details

Compensation: Contractor compensation will be aligned to regional market benchmarks based on the candidate’s country of residence and expressed as monthly salary ranges.


About Organics Ocean

To learn the founder’s story and more about Organics Ocean, visit the website.

The company is a place for innovation. Team roles and responsibilities are clear, and the passion for being a part of something bigger than oneself is shared by everyone. The environment is casual, but the work is serious. Riding this wave of growth only works with A-Players on the team, and that is what everyone is: an A-Player.


Cultural Pillars:

  • Accountability : Take full ownership of your responsibilities and their outcomes. You commit to seeing tasks through, accepting both successes and failures as your own, and continuously learning and improving along the way.
  • Operational Excellence: We believe a strong Foundation is a scalable business. In e-commerce, every action becomes a building block and small cracks compound quickly as we grow. We prioritize building reliable processes, systems, and standards that hold up under scale. We fix breakdowns early, design for consistency, and execute with discipline so growth doesn't introduce chaos.
  • Clarity & Trust: Clarity builds trust, and it goes both ways. Leaders are responsible for setting clear expectations, priorities, and context. Team members are responsible for asking questions, raising their hands, and seeking clarity when something is unclear. When clarity is actively given an actively sought, trust grows, decisions improve, and the teams move faster together.
  • Efficient Leverage: Efficient leverage means doing the right work, not more work. We challenge the status quo, explore better ways of working, and speak up when we see opportunities to improve. We value fresh thinking, but apply it with intention, building systems, making decisions, and creating leverage that drives meaningful impact. Through innovation paired with discipline, we pull the right levers to move the business forward and scale sustainably.
  • Move Fast and Persevere: We push forward with speed and determination, even when things get tough. In the fast-paced world of e-commerce and startups, challenges are inevitable. Success comes from acting quickly, adapting, and staying resilient when obstacles arise. We don’t slow down when things get hard—we press through and keep moving forward.

title: Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer (PHP/Angular)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing, building, and evolving the foundational systems that power the products. This role requires an experienced engineer with strong hands-on expertise in PHP and TypeScript (Angular) who can operate with minimal oversight and deliver pragmatic, customer-focused solutions.

The ideal candidate is an engineer who already possesses deep technical expertise, architectural judgment, and product-oriented thinking — and can apply those skills immediately in a production environment.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable platform services using PHP as a primary backend language
  • Build and maintain frontend systems using TypeScript and Angular
  • Architect and evolve shared platform capabilities used across multiple products and teams
  • Translate product requirements into pragmatic, maintainable technical solutions
  • Apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles and architectural modeling to complex business domains
  • Make sound tradeoffs between ideal architecture and practical delivery timelines
  • Build and integrate systems leveraging LLM-based tools to accelerate development workflows
  • Design and implement features powered by LLMs and agent-based systems, including orchestration, evaluation, and observability
  • Improve engineering velocity through tooling, automation, and thoughtful system design
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product and design teams to ensure technical decisions align with customer needs
  • Contribute to cloud architecture decisions and ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost-aware


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Deep, production-grade experience with PHP
  • Strong front-end development experience using TypeScript and Angular
  • Experience designing and operating distributed systems in production
  • Strong understanding of API design, RESTful services, and event-driven systems and solid knowledge of relational databases and data modeling
  • Practical experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts and architectural models (layered architecture, hexagonal/clean architecture, event-driven architecture, etc.)
  • Demonstrated ability to evolve legacy systems incrementally
  • Ability to design systems that balance correctness, scalability, cost, and delivery speed
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating systems in AWS, with familiarity with core AWS services (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM) and strong understanding of cloud-native patterns, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) is strongly preferred
  • Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in daily development workflows
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into production systems
  • Familiarity with prompt design, evaluation strategies, and reliability patterns
  • Ideally: experience building features or internal tools powered by LLM agents, including orchestration, tool use, guardrails, and monitoring
  • Strong product mindset with p ragmatic decision-maker — prioritizes customer impact over theoretical purity and avoids dogmatic adherence to patterns or tools
  • Experience making technical tradeoffs in ambiguous environments
  • Ability to reason about cost, complexity, maintainability, and time-to-market
  • Highly self-motivated and accountable, with the ability to drive initiatives independently from concept to production with minimal oversight
  • Comfortable operating in environments with evolving requirements


Desired Experience

  • Experience with other major cloud providers (GCP or Azure) is a plus
  • Experience defining platform strategy or technical direction across teams
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising overall engineering standards
  • Proven track record of modernizing systems at scale
  • Experience designing developer platforms or internal tooling ecosystems
  • Strong opinions loosely held — able to debate rigorously and adapt when new information emerges


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Professor de alemão
description:
Vaga para Professor de Alemão (REMOTO)


Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um professor de alemão qualificado e dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe de ensino online no Instituto Stephanie Lich. Se você é um profissional experiente em ensino online, organizado, atento às demandas específicas de cada aluno, e busca uma oportunidade em uma instituição que valoriza o desenvolvimento contínuo e oferece suporte constante ao professor, essa vaga é para você!


Requisitos:

  • Disponibilidade: Flexibilidade de horário, para atender à crescente demanda de alunos que chegam de forma orgânica por meio das nossas redes e marketing e parcerias.


  • Experiência e Flexibilidade: Experiência comprovada no ensino remoto de alemão e experiência e flexibilidade para utilizar diversoso materiais didáticos em sala de aula.


  • Habilidades Tecnológicas: Domínio de plataformas de ensino online, como salas de aula virtuais com lousa digital e aplicativos complementares. O pleno domínio do Google Meet é imprescindível.

Competências


  • Capacidade de conduzir aulas interativas e envolventes, usando diversas ferramentas tecnológicas para otimizar o aprendizado.


  • É fundamental atenção às demandas e necessidades dos alunos em prol de garantir um ensino personalizado e eficaz.

Suporte ao Professor: Fornecemos todo o suporte necessário, incluindo um convênio Google para utilizações de ferramentes pagas pelo Instituto, materiais didáticos atualizados para facilitar o processo de ensino e um material didático próprio do Instituto.


Ambiente de Trabalho: Um ambiente colaborativo e de apoio, onde valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos professores e incentivamos o aprimoramento constante.


Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e, juntos, proporcionar uma experiência de aprendizado única para nossos alunos!

title: Account Executive
description:
About UserGuiding


UserGuiding is a leader in the digital adoption field and has earned a 'Best Software' placement on G2 for two consecutive years. We work with globally recognized companies such as TOTVS, WEG, Caju, Wolters Kluwer, DigitalOcean, and Philip Morris International.


Role Objective


UserGuiding is looking for a results-driven, trilingual Account Executive to spearhead our growth across the Americas. Your primary mission is to lead our expansion in the Brazilian market, while also capturing opportunities in North America and Spanish-speaking LATAM.


You will own the entire revenue pipeline for your region, serving as the primary point of contact for prospects from their first discovery call to their final signature.


Main Responsibilities


1. Full-Cycle Sales & Closing


  • Execute Inbound/Outbound: Manage inbound leads and signups from Brazil, the US, and LATAM. Perform high-impact discovery calls and tailored product demos.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Lead contract negotiations and overcome objections to convert signups into long-term partners.
  • Cross-Regional Support: While focused on Brazil (Portuguese), you will leverage your time to handle inbound calls and outreach for the US (English) and other LATAM countries (Spanish).


2. Pipeline Generation & Outreach


  • Proactive Prospecting: Engage with high-intent signups and conduct outbound outreach to key decision-makers (Product People and UX Designers).
  • Event Advocacy: Attend and represent UserGuiding at major industry events and meetups in Brazil to build a self-sustaining pipeline.
  • Thought Leadership: Regularly share insights, product updates, and industry trends to build a personal brand that attracts inbound interest on LinkedIn.


3. Strategy & CRM Excellence


  • Market Insights: Feed local market trends and customer needs back to our Product and Marketing teams to help refine our messaging in the region.
  • Hubspot Management: Maintain 100% CRM accuracy, ensuring all deals are properly forecasted and followed up on.


Candidate Profile & Experience


  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a sales-centric role, with at least 1 year specifically as an Account Executive within a B2B SaaS startup.


Linguistic Versatility:


  • Portuguese: Native-level (Primary market focus).
  • English: Professional fluency (Internal coordination & North American deals).
  • Spanish: High proficiency (Managing Spanish-speaking LATAM territories).


  • Skills: Strong consultative selling skills, public speaking confidence, and the ability to navigate a \"no-code\" technical environment. We don’t want someone to show our playground in the first minute. Our sales calls should be in the interview format.


Tech Stack


  • Sales: Hubspot CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo.io
  • Comm: Google Meet, Slack.


Compensation & Benefits


  • Base Salary: Competitive fixed monthly salary.
  • Variable Bonus: Uncapped quarterly bonuses based on New Business Revenue (NBR) and pipeline targets.
  • Impact: A high-autonomy role where you directly influence UserGuiding's global expansion strategy.

title: Analista de Administração Pessoal e Benefícios Junior
description:
Responsável por assegurar a correta administração dos processos de ponto, benefícios e apoio aos cálculos de folha de pagamento, garantindo conformidade legal, acuracidade das informações e cumprimento de prazos. Atuará no controle e conferência de dados trabalhistas, apoiando a consistência dos lançamentos, mitigação de riscos e melhoria contínua dos processos de administração de pessoal.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar a gestão e conferência do controle de ponto eletrônico, tratando inconsistências, banco de horas, horas extras, afastamentos e escalas.
  • Garantir cumprimento de prazos legais e obrigações acessórias relacionadas à compra, cadastro e disponibilização dos benefícios.
  • Atuar na interface com fornecedores de folha e benefícios, assegurando qualidade e precisão das informações.

  • Administrar benefícios (vale-transporte, vale-refeição/alimentação, plano de saúde, seguro, entre outros), incluindo movimentações, inclusões, exclusões e conferências de faturas.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e controles internos relacionados aos benefícios.
  • Apoiar o controle e cálculo de férias, 13º salário, admissões, desligamentos e encargos sociais.


Formação e Conhecimentos

  • Nível superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Gestão de RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em administração de pessoal e rotinas de folha de pagamento.
  • Vivência com controle de ponto eletrônico e gestão de benefícios.
  • Conhecimento de legislação trabalhista e encargos sociais.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado.
  • Desejável experiência com sistemas de folha e e-Social.

title: PESSOA COORDENADORA DE CIÊNCIA DE DADOS - REMOTO
description:
Descrição da vaga

A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.


Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão Anglo, PH, Plurall, Líder em Mim e outras. Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. Além disso, buscamos liderar as escolas no processo de transformação digital, visando ser o principal agente de reinvenção da educação para o aluno e a escola do século XXI.


Para cumprir essa missão e entregar o melhor para as nossas escolas, baseamos nosso trabalho em valores fundamentais. Valorizamos a autonomia e o apoio, o bem-estar, a excelência, a liderança e a inovação em nossa rotina de trabalho. Somos o único grupo educacional classificado como uma das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar, Great Place to Work – GPTW.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Coordenar a equipe de tecnologia, garantindo a qualidade e integridade das informações;

- Realizar análise de dados, utilizando técnicas de Business Intelligence e Data Mining;

- Gerenciar o banco de dados e implementar soluções de Big Data;

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
About Able

Able is the AI front office for Wholesale Plumbing, HVAC, and Electrical Suppliers. We're automating the soul-crushing manual work that buries inside sales teams - starting with fixture quoting.


The Wholesale Supply market is a $350B+ market running on spreadsheets and tribal knowledge. We're building the infrastructure to change that.


About the Role

Founding Engineer, with a focus on shipping Agents. You'll spec features, debug weird edge cases, scale infrastructure and help us figure out what to build next based on what customers actually need.

We're not looking for someone who needs a roadmap handed to them. We're looking for somebody who wants to help build the roadmap. If you see a problem, you fix it. If you don't know something, you learn it.


What we're looking for

  • 3 to 5 years of Software Engineering experience
  • Backend depth — you're comfortable owning a Python/FastAPI service end-to-end, from async request handling to data modeling to production debugging
  • Agent & LLM Fluent - you understand how agentic systems work and the failure modes that arise
  • Cloud comfortable - GCP, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Vercel, & Docker. You don't need to be an infra specialist but you shouldn't be scared of it
  • Document intelligence - comfortable working with document parsing & extraction pipelines (OCR, layout analysis, structured extraction, etc)


You're Likely a Fit If

  • You've designed, built, and shipped something with LLMs or Agents with real users
  • You're comfortable making decisions and backing up your logic
  • You default to shipping over planning. Iteration > Perfection
  • You've worked in an early-stage company before and are ready for the chaos
  • You're a tinkerer - also playing around with new technologies or projects


What You'll Do

  • Work with the Founding team to collect user feedback, design feature specs, implement updates, and deploy to production
  • Work across the stack: Python/FastAPI, Next.js/Typescript, Firebase, Docker, GCP, etc
  • Debug production issues and make them obsolete
  • Build and improve agent workflows using home grown frameworks
  • Help shape the product roadmap
  • Stay up to date on modern agent architectures/improvements and implement where
  • necessary


Want some Bonus Points?

We've set up an MCP server at ` - candidates who know what to do with it will find something useful

title: Systems Engineer (Data Compression)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


***

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Systems Engineer with deep experience in compression algorithms and high-performance systems.

You will work closely with the core engineering team to help analyze, validate, optimize, and productionize advanced lossless compression technology .

The ideal candidate is both technically rigorous and intellectually curious , capable of investigating unconventional approaches while applying strong systems engineering discipline.


What you'll work on

  • Designing and optimizing lossless compression techniques
  • Evaluating compression performance across different datasets
  • Improving throughput, compression ratio, and memory efficiency
  • Benchmarking and profiling performance-critical systems
  • Building high-performance libraries and services
  • Collaborating with engineers to productionize compression technology

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, C, or other systems languages
  • Experience with performance optimization and profiling
  • Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures
  • Experience building high-performance systems or infrastructure
  • Comfortable working with confidential technology under NDA
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

Nice to have

  • Experience with compression algorithms (LZ, Zstd, Huffman, Brotli, etc.)
  • Background in storage systems, distributed systems, or databases
  • Experience working at cloud providers or infrastructure companies
  • Experience with benchmarking or systems performance testing
  • Familiarity with AI / GenAI development tools


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.


About the Role


As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.


Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.


What You’ll Gain


Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora .NET - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend .NET - Pleno, para atuar em parceria com o maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina, especializado em capital de investimento, de risco, além de gerenciamento de patrimônio e ativos globais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver aplicações Backend .NET

Manter e evoluir sistemas existentes , analisando e depurando códigos com ferramentas como IDEs e DevTools do navegador (F12).

Desenvolver e manter APIs REST com .NET Core e Entity Framework.

Aplicar boas práticas de arquitetura de software , como DDD (Domain-Driven Design), injeção de dependência e testes unitários.

Trabalhar com mensageria , principalmente RabbitMQ, mas também com alternativas como SQS, SNS ou Kafka.

Projetar e manter sistemas distribuídos baseados em microserviços.

Monitorar e diagnosticar aplicações usando ferramentas de observabilidade (ex: DataDog, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch).

Utilizar bancos de dados não relacionais , como MongoDB ou DynamoDB.

Participar de pipelines de CI/CD , garantindo entregas contínuas e seguras.

Trabalhar com tecnologias de containerização e orquestração , como Docker e Kubernetes.

Utilizar serviços em nuvem (AWS, Azure, etc.) , incluindo funções serverless e mensageria.

Colaborar em projetos via Azure DevOps , utilizando boards, pipelines e repositórios.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiencia com .NET
  • EntityFramework
  • Injeção de Dependencia
  • DDD
  • Testes unitários
  • Experiencia com ferramentas de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Sqs, Sns, Kafka), preferencialmente RabbitMQ
  • Experiencia com sistemas distribuídos, com microserviços que interagem entre si;
  • Experiencia com alguma ferramenta de observabilidade/logs, como DataDog, azuremonitor; CloudWatch
  • Banco de dados não relacional (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experiencia com ambiente de trabalho com estrutura de CI-CD
  • Experiencia com pelo menos 3 ferramentas de Cloud(Exemplo: Aws lambda, Azure functions, SQS, SNS, EC2)
  • Experiencia com docker e kubernetes;
  • Experiencia ou conhecimento do Azure DevOps


Soft Skills:

  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;
  • Ter capacidade de comunicação com diversos perfis de stakeholders;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e multidisciplinares;
  • Criatividade e Proatividade para imaginar diferentes cenários de uso das aplicações;
  • Organização.

description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java Sênior para atuar em um ambiente bancário robusto, de alta criticidade e grande impacto no negócio. Procuramos alguém que vá além do código: que entenda contexto, risco, performance e segurança — pilares essenciais do setor financeiro.


O desafio

Você fará parte de times estratégicos responsáveis por sistemas core do banco, com alto volume de transações, foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e qualidade técnica. Aqui, decisões técnicas realmente importam.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar aplicações Java de missão crítica
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Garantir performance, segurança e disponibilidade das aplicações
  • Trabalhar com integrações complexas (APIs, mensageria, sistemas legados)
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e decisões técnicas
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, arquitetura e segurança da informação


Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência com Java (21+)
  • Vivência comprovada no segmento bancário ou financeiro
  • Experiência com Spring / Spring Boot
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
  • Vivência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS ou similares)
  • Conhecimentos em CI/CD, versionamento (Git) e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com sistemas de alta volumetria e baixa latência


Diferenciais

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.


This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.


What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.


2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
  • Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.


Who We're Looking For

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks.
  • Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent).
  • Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion.
  • Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems.
  • Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models.
  • Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

  • The ideal profile is a generalist , not a specialist.
  • Key expectations include:
  • Writing production grade code
  • Designing scalable systems
  • Orchestrating end to end data and ML pipelines
  • Integrating ML models into broader systems
  • SQL is considered an additional skill , not the core focus.

description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend .NET - Pleno, para atuar em parceria com o maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina, especializado em capital de investimento, de risco, além de gerenciamento de patrimônio e ativos globais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver aplicações Backend .NET

Manter e evoluir sistemas existentes , analisando e depurando códigos com ferramentas como IDEs e DevTools do navegador (F12).

Utilizar serviços em nuvem (AWS, Azure, etc.) , incluindo funções serverless e mensageria.

Colaborar em projetos via Azure DevOps , utilizando boards, pipelines e repositórios.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiencia com .NET
  • EntityFramework
  • Injeção de Dependencia
  • DDD
  • Testes unitários
  • Experiencia com ferramentas de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Sqs, Sns, Kafka), preferencialmente RabbitMQ
  • Experiencia com sistemas distribuídos, com microserviços que interagem entre si;
  • Experiencia com alguma ferramenta de observabilidade/logs, como DataDog, azuremonitor; CloudWatch
  • Banco de dados não relacional (MongoDB, DynamoDB)

  • Experiencia com pelo menos 3 ferramentas de Cloud(Exemplo: Aws lambda, Azure functions, SQS, SNS, EC2)
  • Experiencia com docker e kubernetes;
  • Experiencia ou conhecimento do Azure DevOps


Soft Skills:

  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;
  • Ter capacidade de comunicação com diversos perfis de stakeholders;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e multidisciplinares;
  • Criatividade e Proatividade para imaginar diferentes cenários de uso das aplicações;
  • Organização.

title: Profissional Cientista de Dados
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Estamos buscando um(a) Cientista de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Inteligência Artificial, com foco no desenvolvimento de agentes corporativos baseados em LLMs .

Buscamos profissional com:

✔️ +5 anos em Ciência de Dados / Machine Learning

✔️ Experiência prática com IA Generativa e LLMs

✔️ Arquitetura RAG (embeddings, bancos vetoriais, retrieval)

✔️ Construção de agentes (ReAct / tool calling)

✔️ Prompt engineering e mitigação de hallucinations

✔️ Python, NLP, APIs REST, SQL

✔️ Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

  • Please prioritize senior-level Data/MLOps Engineers with strong coding ability and clear communication. Candidates must be able to clearly explain their approach, design decisions, trade offs, and alternatives, and articulate end-to-end MLOps architecture. Candidates with average coding skills or limited ability to communicate ideas will not be considered.


Data Engineer (MLOps Focus)Team & Scope

  • The team owns the entire data pipeline , from ingestion to downstream consumption.
  • Data Engineering and MLOps responsibilities are combined , and the team supports multiple projects simultaneously.
  • This is primarily a Data Engineering role , with strong exposure to MLOps and ML integration .

Technical Focus

  • The team writes significantly less SQL compared to a typical Data Engineering team.
  • There is a large Business Analyst team responsible for providing raw data and writing most of the SQL.
  • Candidates must be comfortable with SQL , but in day to day work, SQL usage is limited.
  • Strong programming and system design skills are critical, similar to a traditional Software Engineering role.
  • Python is the main programming language, but strong experience in Java or Scala is also acceptable.
  • The ideal profile is a generalist , not a specialist.
  • Key expectations include:
  • Writing production grade code
  • Designing scalable systems
  • Orchestrating end to end data and ML pipelines
  • Integrating ML models into broader systems
  • SQL is considered an additional skill , not the core focus.





Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Engenheiro de Dados I (Senior)- Azure Fabric
description:
Sobre a Tivit Alma Viva:

Somos uma multinacional brasileira de tecnologia que impulsiona negócios por meio de soluções digitais, cloud, cibersegurança e tecnologia de ponta. Nosso propósito é transformar, inovar e simplificar a jornada digital de nossos clientes.


Sua missão

Buscamos um Engenheiro de Dados Sr, para liderar migração de plataformas legadas para arquiteturas modernas de analytics em cloud, otimizando performance, reduzindo custos e garantindo qualidade dos dados.



Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis em cloud (Azure Fabric, Databricks)
  • Desenhar pipelines de ingestão em tempo real e batch (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus)
  • Modelar Data Lakehouses com Delta Lake e otimizar particionamento
  • Definir estratégias de governança e segurança (Purview, RBAC, data lineage)
  • Migração e Modernização
  • Converter sistemas legados para plataformas modernas
  • Traduzir lógica complexa de stored procedures para PySpark/SQL
  • Validar integridade de dados pós-migração e corrigir discrepâncias
  • Implementar processos de delta load e CDC (Change Data Capture)
  • Performance e Qualidade
  • Otimizar queries e processamentos para grande volume de dados
  • Estabelecer deduplicação e validação de schemas
  • Implementar monitoramento e observabilidade (Application Insights)
  • Documentação e Colaboração
  • Documentar arquiteturas com diagramas técnicos
  • Criar mapeamentos DE-PARA entre sistemas legados e novos
  • Trabalhar com stakeholders de negócio e times de BI/analytics


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ensino Superior Completo
  • Visão end-to-end (ingestão até consumo)
  • Atenção a detalhes e qualidade de dados
  • Resiliência para troubleshooting complexo
  • Comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e negócio
  • Autonomia e proatividade
  • PySpark / Apache Spark (transformações complexas, window functions, joins)
  • SQL avançado (CTEs, window functions, otimização)
  • Microsoft Fabric e Databricks (Lakehouse, Delta Lake)
  • Azure (Event Hubs, Storage, Data Factory, Key Vault)
  • Modelagem dimensional e normalização
  • Git e CI/CD
  • Kafka e streaming em tempo reale NRT
  • Power BI (Direct Lake, DAX)
  • Oracle Siebel ou CRMs enterprise
  • Python para automação
  • Schemas JSON/Parquet
  • Microsoft Purview


Outros Diferenciais :

  • Experiência com migração de sistemas legados
  • Redução de custos operacionais e FinOps
  • Certificações Azure (DP-203, AZ-305)



Informações adicionais


O que oferecemos para você?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência médica e Odontológica;
  • Convênio Farmácia (descontos na compra de medicamentos);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • TIVIT Club (descontos e parcerias com as melhores lojas);
  • PAC - Programa de aceleração de carreira;
  • Reembolso para certificações;
  • MOBIFLIX – Nossa academia corporativa tem cursos presenciais e online, alinhados as novas tendências do mercado de tecnologia;
  • Plataforma online de crédito consignado, a TIVIT te ajuda a realizar os seus objetivos pessoais como reforma no seu apê/casa, financiar estudos e quitar dívidas, de acordo com as regras e políticas da cia;




Acreditamos que o presente é plural e a inclusão transforma, por isso, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas em nossas vagas, para promovermos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, de respeito, justiça e equidade.


Topa embarcar nesse desafio com a gente? #vemserTIVIT

title: Data Engineer Powercenter (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • +3years of experience as a Data Engineer with Informatica PowerCenter .
  • Strong knowledge of ETL processes and development of complex workflows and data pipelines.
  • Experience with Informatica Cloud / CDI-PC / IICS , including design, implementation, and maintenance of cloud data integration pipelines .
  • Experience in developing integrated solutions and creating complex workflows in a corporate data environment.
  • Ability to plan, monitor, and deliver projects within timelines and budget.
  • Experience in testing, data quality, and defect management.
  • Good command of English.
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal (Porto or Lisbon); eligible for a Portuguese work visa or holding EU/dual nationality.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Kotlin/.NET (AWS) SR
description:
Atividades:

  • Desenvolver e manter microserviços e APIs REST em Kotlin (Ktor/Spring) e .NET (ASP.NET Core).
  • Modelar dados e integrações com sistemas legados e mensageria (RDS/SQL Server, DynamoDB, SQS/Kafka).
  • Implementar e operar soluções na AWS com Docker e automação (ECS/EKS ou Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM).
  • Garantir qualidade e segurança com testes, code review e compliance (OAuth2/OIDC, LGPD).
  • Atuar em incidentes e melhoria contínua, monitorando SLOs e performance.

  • Experiência sólida com Kotlin e C#/.NET Core em produção (APIs e processamento assíncrono).
  • Vivência em AWS: compute (ECS/EKS/Lambda), dados (RDS/DynamoDB) e filas (SQS/SNS), observabilidade básica.
  • Banco de dados e transações: SQL avançado, ORM (Hibernate/JPA, EF Core) e otimização de performance.
  • Contêineres e CI/CD: Docker, Git e pipelines (GitHub Actions/CodePipeline); IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation) desejável.
  • Boas práticas: TDD, Clean Architecture/DDD e segurança para o setor financeiro (criptografia, auditoria, segregação de acessos).

  • Atuação remota

title: Senior Tech Lead (Angular + .NET)
description:
Senior Tech Lead (Angular + .NET)

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: PJ

Horário: 06h30 às 15h30 (BRT)


Você será referência técnica do time, liderando decisões arquiteturais e atuando de forma hands-on no desenvolvimento front-end e back-end, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e segurança das soluções.
